--join https://discord.gg/eTHyrcqXcA

local rf = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("_Index"):WaitForChild("sleitnick_knit@1.4.7"):WaitForChild("knit"):WaitForChild("Services"):WaitForChild("MiningService"):WaitForChild("RF"):WaitForChild("HitRock")

while true do
    for _, block in workspace.MineBlocks:GetChildren() do
        task.spawn(function()
            local id = block:GetAttribute("BlockId") or block.Name -- you can put GridX, Y, Z, Ore type, Rarity, Health and MaxHealth
            rf:InvokeServer(id)
        end)
    end
    task.wait(.1) -- this can lag your pc.
end
